title: MetricFlow Metric Query Latency p95
app: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow query logs via the JDBC/GraphQL API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=semantic_layer:query status="success"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by metric_name
| where p95_s>5
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile query latency for each metric in MetricFlow and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking MetricFlow metrics by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest MetricFlow timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest metrics with their owners.
visualization: Table of metric by p95 query latency, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in MetricFlow so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
